summary: Fresh-install RC with the reviewed native PostgreSQL baseline applied by a dedicated Prisma CLI 7.9.1 pre-sync Job. The single-invocation installer preinstalls exact Argo CD 3.5.0 CRDs before mapping Applications, and migration waits boundedly for PostgreSQL through DNS-only plus database egress. API and worker remain read-only schema verifiers; PostgreSQL functions, triggers, constraints, and indexes stay native SQL. Pre-Prisma RC databases are rejected.
